scope: Fresh official-source release check for the 15 named core methods plus FLAME (16 checks). Web access only; no downloads, installs or execution.

status_definitions.advertised: Official source explicitly documents code, model/checkpoint or data availability/instructions.
status_definitions.unverified: The checked official source did not establish the requested artifact; this does not prove it is private or nonexistent.
status_definitions.not_acquired: No asset was downloaded into this project.

checks.findings: Official README says inference/fitting and pretrained models were released; ViT-S and ViT-B checkpoints downloadable via Google Drive; single-image path defaults ViT-B. FLAME2023 separately licensed. Training data marked coming soon.

Official page request returned 502 on 2026-10-23. Project release audit dated 2026-10-11 records FLAME2023 Open under CC-BY-4.0 and converter link; that is prior evidence, not a successful fresh page check. Older FLAME asset terms differ.
Official README instructs obtaining pretrained MICA checkpoint and separate FLAME2020 model; FLAME account/registration and InsightFace assets are additional requirements.

Official README instructs running install_preprocessing_pipeline.sh to download network weights and preprocessing dependencies; FLAME/MICA assets required. Inference includes single-image fitting. NC license is shown in repo.
assets_advertised: UV and normal network weights via setup script

checks.findings: Official README documents quick_install downloading pretrained SMIRK model and FLAME (registration required), single-image demo and train.py. It notes original LRS3 source is removed and suggests substitute dataset.

Official repository contains inference demos, training entry point and fetch_data.sh asset setup. This check did not separately acquire or hash the model checkpoint; fetch/setup instructions are not an acquired artifact.

Official repo identifies EMOCA v2 and old release; README calls EMOCA deprecated and points to Inferno FaceReconstruction as superior current system. This check did not acquire weights. Legacy conda/CUDA environment is described.
Official README describes pretrained model/assets download and single-view inference; head extension models announced via ModelScope. README explicitly says training code has not been released.

Official project page links ICCV paper, supplementary PDF, poster and media; no executable implementation or checkpoint link found in checked page. Do not infer that artifacts are private/nonexistent.

Current README advertises public Ava256-Scan and lower-cost training; current TEST.md says provided downloadable weights are identical to paper OpenDelight trained on FaceOLAT plus private Light Stage scan dataset. Public dataset release does not establish that provided checkpoint was retrained on Ava256-Scan. Preserve this discrepancy.
assets_advertised: pretrained OpenDelight checkpoint via Google Drive

checks.findings: Official README provides download_weights.py for Hugging Face checkpoints/topology; base LongCat model loaded separately. It advertises HF training data. Code MIT does not grant all third-party model/data/topology terms; compatible FLAME topology is not supplied by baseline.

The checked URL redirects to Ubisoft FFHQ-UV-Intrinsics dataset repository. It documents 10K research-only intrinsic maps on Hifi3D topology, not a MoSAR model checkpoint/code release. Dataset cannot be treated as FLAME-native without topology conversion.
assets_advertised: FFHQ-UV-Intrinsics Git LFS dataset (research only; topology Hifi3D)

checks.findings: Official project-page URL could not be fetched by the web source on 2026-10-23; CVF paper is indexed. This check did not establish executable code or weights. Unavailable page is not proof that artifacts do not exist.

Official repo README advertises implementation, single-image reflectance inference and distributed training scripts. This page check did not confirm an accessible pretrained checkpoint link or acquire weights; reflectance data requirements remain separate.

Official public GitHub repository contains a README/title and project link, no listed checkpoint or code files beyond README in checked view; no Releases listed. Do not infer weights are private/nonexistent.
Official repository README says Code Coming Soon; Releases page says there are no releases. No executable code/checkpoint was advertised in checked view.
